mapper.sql: id, knowledge_base_id, name, path, file_type, file_size, status, chunk_count, error_msg, create_time, update_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM kb_file WHERE knowledge_base_id = #{knowledgeBaseId} ORDER BY create_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO kb_file (knowledge_base_id, name, path, file_type, file_size, status, chunk_count, error_msg, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{knowledgeBaseId}, #{name}, #{path}, #{fileType}, #{fileSize}, #{status}, #{chunkCount}, #{errorMsg}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE kb_file SET knowledge_base_id = #{knowledgeBaseId}, name = #{name}, path = #{path}, file_type = #{fileType}, file_size = #{fileSize}, status = #{status}, chunk_count = #{chunkCount}, error_msg = #{errorMsg}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE id = #{id}
